summary: Merkium's current models (ganymede-1.1, pluto-1.2-flash, pluto-1.2-pro, ceres-1.0, ceres-1.0-pro, pluto-1.1-flash, pluto-1.1-pro) are free permanently in Merkium chat and through the API, with no charge per request or per token. The free tier allows 30 requests per minute per API key. API keys are free and need no credit card. Future models may be paid.
claim_steps: Create a free API key in the Merkium Console at chat.merkium.nl (no credit card)
Use a free model ID (e.g. pluto-1.2-pro) as the model field of an API request
